claims.clause: correct target is proven from the intended repository, not from a name string
claims.evidence: CONTROL/correct_target.py bind_target() + normalise_remote_url(); tests RemoteUrlIdentity.test_one_repository_has_one_identity_across_spellings, WrongTarget.test_the_repository_name_cannot_override_the_observed_url, WrongTarget.test_a_foreign_remote_url_is_refused_as_wrong_target. IntendedTarget refuses construction without an accepted remote URL, so a bare repository name can never be the witness.

claims.clause: landing is proven on REMOTE main, not local main
claims.evidence: prove_landing() reads git.remote_head(remote, branch) and tests merge_commit ancestry against it; LocalOnlyMerge.test_a_merge_in_local_history_but_not_remote_main_is_local_only, LocalOnlyMerge.test_an_absent_remote_branch_is_local_only.

claims.clause: wrong-target and local-only are distinguishable refusals
claims.evidence: REASONS carries both; probe returns reason 'wrong-target' for a foreign remote URL and reason 'local-only' for a merge held only in local history; LocalOnlyMerge.test_local_only_and_wrong_target_are_distinguishable asserts the reasons and strings differ; WrongTarget.test_wrong_target_is_refused_before_any_ancestry_is_examined asserts ordering.

claims.clause: uncertain merge/ack reconciles once without duplicate landing
claims.evidence: reconcile_once() appends one landing record on first reconcile, returns ALREADY_RECONCILED with zero writes on repeat (byte-identical journal asserted), and raises landing-conflict for a second different landing while leaving the journal untouched: ReconcileOnce.test_first_reconcile_writes_exactly_one_landing, .test_repeated_reconcile_of_the_same_uncertain_merge_writes_nothing (3 retries), .test_a_different_landing_for_the_same_unit_is_refused_not_appended, .test_two_units_accumulate_two_distinct_landings, .test_a_malformed_journal_is_refused_rather_than_overwritten.

claims.clause: N999 need not wait for ONB fixture facets
claims.evidence: N999NeedsNoOnbFacet.test_n999_proves_on_its_own_transport_and_urls proves a 999-setup landing using only 999 URL identities; there is no ONB module import and no ONB fixture read. Cross-flavor isolation is also asserted in both directions.

claims.clause: the proof carries its own target identity so it cannot float to another repository
claims.evidence: LandingProof.as_dict() embeds target {repository, remote, branch, accepted_remotes} plus the observed remote_url; CorrectTarget.test_proof_names_the_full_target_so_it_cannot_float_to_another_repo. A foreign-target proof offered to a journal already holding this unit is refused as landing-conflict (ReconcileOnce.test_a_landing_for_a_foreign_target_is_refused_into_this_journal).
